claim: Fox scheduled the premiere of The Rocky Horror Picture Show remake for Halloween night.
explanation: The claim states that Fox scheduled the premiere of The Rocky Horror Picture Show remake for Halloween night, but the source evidence indicates that the project is actually timed to celebrate the 40th anniversary of the film, which has grossed more than $112 million and still plays in theaters across the country. The source also mentions that the special will be filmed in advance and not air live, but few details beyond that are known. There is no mention of a Halloween night premiere in the source evidence.
